The filing's own cash-flow reconciliation proves the investing/capex amount is $0, not an undisclosed purchase (CMPS-style proof).

overrides_applied.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-04, accession 0001287750-26-000006), Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows and Note 9 (Stockholders' Equity): no share-based/stock-based compensation line or adjustment appears among the operating adjustments, the filing contains no equity-incentive or stock-compensation note, and Note 9 reports stock issued only by sale (ATM offerings — 42.4M shares for $937.2M gross proceeds in 2025) and, in 2024, on conversion of the 2024 convertible notes — no stock grants to anyone, including non-employee directors, and no stock-compensation expense amount is reported anywhere in the filing.
overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:sbc — SBC missing for FY2023, FY2024, FY2025 under the engine's tags because ARCC is externally managed by Ares Capital Management LLC and has no employees of its own to compensate with stock: the adviser bears personnel compensation, and ARCC pays it base and incentive management fees instead (already expensed inside net investment income / net income). The filer reports no SBC in any period.
